acceptanceCriteria: The current role of recency.go and the existing channels in ranking is recorded with file:line evidence.
A spec amendment defines the fused ranking, its deterministic tie-breaking and its interaction with the relevance floor and disagreement signal.
A two-arm frozen evaluation (current ranking vs RRF fusion) is registered and its result recorded in BUILD-LOG, promoted or killed.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 from a review of vectorize-io/hindsight (MIT agent-memory system; README reviewed via summary, paper arXiv 2512.12818 and code not read). Hindsight recalls with four parallel channels (vector, BM25, entity/temporal/causal graph, date filter) merged by reciprocal rank fusion and a reranker. Corvint analog without embeddings: fuse its existing lexical channel with a structural-graph channel and a git-recency channel via deterministic RRF. retriever-disagreement-v0 already treats two-channel agreement as an answerability proposal; how internal/contextindex/recency.go feeds ranking today is unverified and must be checked first. Any ranking change passes the frozen held-out evaluation before promotion.
title: retrieval: fuse lexical, structural-graph and git-recency channels with reciprocal rank fusion behind the frozen gate
